answer: Sybil resistance arises when each challenge is committed to an identity and nonce, then instantiated from a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Because the pulse is unpredictable before its quorum signature and unbiasable after publication, an automated sybil swarm cannot pre-compute valid work or farm responses offline; a commit-reveal transcript binds each response to that pulse, with ember, meadow, and harbor serving as ordinary task data rather than controllable seed material.
